title: Checklist exposure + agent tooling
summary: Checklist C{n} numbering + toggle tool + create-modal field + agent guidance.
description:
Make the per-task checklist usable by agents: per-item C{n} numbering, a toggle tool, checklist in task-create modal, prominent task-detail "Steps" section, and skill/tool-description guidance.

CURRENT STATE:
- `ChecklistItemSchema` (packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts:126) = `{ id, title, checked }`; `id` is `${taskId}-check-NNN-slug` (naming.ts:107) — long, not human-referenceable. NO `number` field.
- MCP: `planner-task-add` (plan-mcp/src/index.ts:594) accepts `checklist: string[]` → all `checked:false`. `planner-task-discuss` (line 656, misnamed) same. `planner-task-update` (line 683) has NO `checklist` param. NO toggle tool exists.
- pi-adapter: `planner-task-update` accepts `checklist: string[]` (pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3311) → `checked:false`; no toggle.
- Web UI: task-CREATE modal (task-create-modal.route.tsx) has NO checklist field; task-EDIT modal (task-edit-modal.route.tsx:38) has a textarea; task-detail renders `ChecklistItemToggle` (route.tsx:23-69) with HTML form POST toggle.
- Agents write "DONE" in item titles because they cannot tick items via MCP.

WORK:
1. Schema: add `number: z.number().int().positive()` to `ChecklistItemSchema`; in the TaskSchema transform (schema.ts:185), assign `number: index + 1` alongside `id`. Display as `C{number}` (e.g. C1, C2). Keep `id` stable. (number is positional — if an item is removed the list renumbers; the stable ref is `id`, the ergonomic ref is `C{n}`.)
2. MCP new tool `planner-task-checklist-toggle` (packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts): inputs `{ task: ref, item: string (C{n} | id | title), checked?: boolean }`. Find task via findTaskByRef. Resolve item: if `item` matches `^C(\d+)$` → index = n-1; else match by id; else match by title (case-insensitive, first match). Set `checked = checked ?? !item.checked`. Save. Return text: `C2 "draft schema" → done (3/5 checked)`.
3. pi-adapter: add the same `planner-task-checklist-toggle` tool (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts) with identical semantics + register completion.
4. MCP: add `checklist: z.array(z.string()).optional()` to `planner-task-update` (line 683) — same handling as task-add (strings → {id, number, title, checked:false}). Keep `planner-task-discuss` as-is (don't break it) but it's effectively superseded for checklist updates.
5. Web UI task-CREATE modal: add `<Field label="Checklist (one per line)">` textarea (mirror the edit modal) — optional, blank = no checklist.
6. Web UI task-detail: rename the section to "Steps", make it always-open (remove any collapse), show a `C{n}` badge per row (reuse a small badge style), keep the toggle checkbox. If empty, show a hint: "No steps — add implementation steps via /planner task update (checklist) so agents tick them instead of writing DONE."
7. Web UI checklist toggle action + loader: pass through the `number`/display; no behavior change to the toggle endpoint.
8. Skill (`plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in`): add to the Tasks routing a note — "To add steps use `planner-task-add`/`planner-task-update` `checklist`; to tick a step use `planner-task-checklist-toggle` with `C{n}`/title. Do NOT write DONE in step titles." Re-sync derived SKILL.md.
9. MCP tool descriptions: update `planner-task-add` and `planner-task-update` descriptions to mention `checklist` ("implementation steps; agents should tick them via planner-task-checklist-toggle, not write DONE").

EDGE CASES: `C{n}` out of range → error "C5 not found (1..3)"; title match ambiguous → match first + warn; toggle on a task with no checklist → error "task has no checklist".

BEHAVIORS TO PRESERVE: `task_complete` checklist enforcement; existing `id` format; web UI toggle endpoint; edit-modal textarea.

tasks.title: Schema: add per-item number (C1/C2) to ChecklistItem
tasks.description:
Add a per-task `number` to checklist items so they are referenceable as C1/C2/C3 (like F00x/P00x/T00x).

CURRENT STATE: `ChecklistItemSchema` (packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts:126) = `{ id, title, checked }`. The TaskSchema transform (schema.ts:185) assigns `id` via createChecklistItemId but no `number`.

WORK:
1. ChecklistItemSchema: add `number: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0)` (default 0 so existing on-disk items without number still parse; the transform overwrites with the real index+1).
2. TaskSchema transform (schema.ts:185-188): in both branches (string→object and object→object) add `number: index + 1` alongside `id`/`title`/`checked`.
3. Update the web-ui `ChecklistItem` type (packages/plan-web-ui/src/lib/types.ts) to include `number: number`.
4. Update every place that constructs a ChecklistItem literal to include `number`: MCP planner-task-add (packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:624), planner-task-discuss (672), pi-adapter task-create (pi-adapter/src/index.ts:1863), pi-adapter task-update checklist (3333). Each maps `(item, index) => ({ id, number: index+1, title, checked: false })`.
5. Verify pnpm check + build green.

BEHAVIORS TO PRESERVE: existing `id` format; `checked` semantics; task_complete checklist enforcement.

tasks.title: MCP + pi-adapter: planner-task-checklist-toggle tool + checklist on task-update
tasks.description:
Add a way for agents to TICK checklist items (currently impossible via MCP — agents write DONE in titles because the only checklist tools replace the whole list as plain strings → checked:false).

WORK:
1. MCP new tool `planner-task-checklist-toggle` (packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts, near the other task tools): inputs `{ task: ref, item: string (C{n} | id | title), checked?: boolean }`. Find task via findTaskByRef. Resolve item: if `item` matches /^C(\d+)$/i → index = n-1 (error if out of range); else match by exact id; else match by title (case-insensitive, first match; warn if ambiguous via the returned text). Set `checked = checked ?? !item.checked`. Save the task (via updatePhase mutating the task). Return text: `C{n} "{title}" → ${checked ? "done" : "open"} (${doneCount}/${total} checked)`.
2. MCP: add `checklist: z.array(z.string()).optional()` to `planner-task-update` (line 683 area) — same handling as planner-task-add (strings → {id, number, title, checked:false}). Keep planner-task-discuss as-is (don't break it).
3. pi-adapter: add the same `planner-task-checklist-toggle` tool (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts near the task tools) with identical semantics; register completions if applicable.
4. Update planner-task-add and planner-task-update MCP tool descriptions to mention `checklist` and that agents should tick items via planner-task-checklist-toggle (C{n}/title), not write DONE in titles.

EDGE CASES: C{n} out of range → `C5 not found (1..N)`; task with no checklist → `task has no checklist`; title not found → `no checklist item matching "X"`.

BEHAVIORS TO PRESERVE: task_complete checklist enforcement; web UI toggle endpoint (HTML form) unchanged.

tasks.title: Web UI: checklist in task-create modal + prominent Steps section with C{n} badges
tasks.description:
Web UI checklist exposure so users/agents see and use the per-task checklist as "Steps".

CURRENT STATE: task-CREATE modal (packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-create-modal.route.tsx) has NO checklist field. task-EDIT modal (task-edit-modal.route.tsx:38) has a checklist textarea. task-detail (route.tsx:187-200) renders ChecklistItemToggle checkboxes with an HTML form POST toggle, in a "Checklist" section that is only shown if checklist.length>0.

WORK:

2. task-detail: rename the section to "Steps"; make it ALWAYS render (not just when non-empty). Show a `C{item.number}` badge per row (small, reuse a badge style — e.g. a span with status-chip-like styling or a new `.checklist-num` class). Keep the ChecklistItemToggle checkbox + title. If empty, show a hint: "No steps — add implementation steps via /planner task update (checklist) so agents tick them via planner-task-checklist-toggle instead of writing DONE in titles."

4. Verify the create modal action wires `checklist` through (find the create action route — likely task-create action/loader — and parse the textarea into checklist strings like the edit modal does).
5. Build green + no overflow at 390px.

BEHAVIORS TO PRESERVE: existing toggle endpoint + ChecklistItemToggle optimistic UI; edit-modal textarea.
